summary: Initial release with personal life tracker, multi-user timeline, public plaza, theme modes, and extensive media management features.

items.text: Launched personal life tracker with multi-user support and public plaza.
Added light, dark, and system theme modes with easy switching.
Enabled importing from Goodreads and music search with Spotify integration.
Provided multi-category media management including books, music, watches, and games.
Improved search resilience and editing experience for better usability.
